name: print-partner
description: Connect Cursor to a Print Partner host over streamable HTTP MCP.

PRINT_PARTNER_MCP_URL.description: Streamable HTTP MCP URL. Use https:// for remote hosts; http://127.0.0.1 only for loopback/tunnel.

PRINT_PARTNER_API_KEY.description: Same key as PRINT_PARTNER_API_KEY on the host (Bearer). Required when HOST is not loopback.
